verdict.rationale: Atlas documents a dashboard for activating payments and managing SAFEs, plus a Delaware registered agent, but nothing shows a view listing every entity and state registration with good-standing status and upcoming deadlines. One user mentions filing reminders, but that is an adjacent alert feature, not this dashboard. Community reports say Atlas leaves home-state foreign registration and state- and city-level legwork to the founder, so multi-state registrations would not appear in Atlas at all.
